subject: Hosted API: usage & pricing follow-up (monthly tokens + peak TPS)
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Menon <asha@vitalsync.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-15T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up on today's call — hosted API usage & pricing

Hi Asha — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our side and a couple of clarifying asks so we can put together a pricing teardown aligned with your budget and risk profile.

Recap (what we heard)
- Primary workload: conversational triage + summarization for patient queries (real-time, sub-200 token responses on average).
- Expected baseline traffic: medium volume during weekdays with spikes tied to marketing campaigns and product releases.
- Key success criteria: predictable monthly cost, sub-200ms median token latency, and a clear SLA for peak throughput.

Clarifying asks (so our proposal is tight)
1) Monthly token range: can you confirm an expected low / likely / high for tokens per month? e.g. 25M / 75M / 150M (tokens).
2) Peak TPS: what is the largest sustained TPS you might need for a 5–10 minute window during promotions? Ballpark is fine.
3) Target $/1M tokens or monthly budget range you’re aiming for (helps us model tiered discounts).
4) Procurement timeline & billing entity (so we know whether to include standard PO flow or Docusign + SOW).

Attachments: I attached a short pricing one-pager and a simple template you can fill for token estimates if helpful (vitalsync_volume_estimate.xlsx).

Next steps: If you can reply with the three items above, Marissa and I will put together a 1–pager pricing model showing committed tier vs burst pricing, and a recommended SLA configuration (sustained TPS + burst).

Thanks — kim

--
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0193
Redwood Inference

Attachments: rwd_pricing_onepager.pdf (one-pager), vitalsync_volume_estimate.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Asha Menon <asha@vitalsync.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-16T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up on today's call — hosted API usage & pricing

Thanks Kimberly — good recap. Quick answers below, happy to fill in the spreadsheet as well and loop Tom (ops) for procurement details.

Short answers:
- Monthly tokens (low / likely / high): 30M / 75M / 120M tokens. Our production baseline today is roughly 45M but we expect steady growth over the next 6 months.
- Peak TPS (5–10 minute sustained window): we see periodic peaks up to ~55 TPS; campaign-driven bursts could spike toward 100–120 TPS for ~2–3 minutes.
- Target $/1M tokens: Prefer to land in the $850–$1,000 per 1M tokens range for committed volume; we have an internal monthly budget target of ~$65k–$90k.
- Procurement timeline & billing: target decision by end of June; billing entity is Vitalsync, Inc. (PO + SOW typical).

I'll attach a rough procurement timeline and a filled-first-pass numbers sheet tomorrow.

Best,
Asha

--
Asha Menon
Head of Product, Vitalsync
asha@vitalsync.ai | +1 (650) 555-0138

Attachments: vitalsync_procurement_timeline.pdf (timeline)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Menon <asha@vitalsync.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-16T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up on today's call — hosted API usage & pricing

Asha — perfect, that helps a lot. A few notes and what I'll include in the follow-up pricing packet: 

1) Pricing constructs we'll model for you
- Committed tier (monthly commit with stepped unit price decreases at 50M / 100M thresholds).
- Burst overlay (short-duration peak capacity priced either as a delta TPS surcharge or credit-based bursts).
- Fallback/compat mode (lower-cost quantized model variant we can route to if capacity/budget triggers are hit).

2) What I need from you to finalize numbers
- A quick note in the spreadsheet indicating % of calls that are multi-turn (average turns per session) — that affects token-per-interaction math.
- Any regulatory constraints (we can include Private deployment pricing in the model if you need VPC/controlled logs).

3) Latency & SLA options
- We can propose two levels: Standard (p50 token latency <200ms; 50 TPS sustained) and Premium (p50 <120ms; 100 TPS sustained, bursts to 250 TPS). Please indicate which you prefer to model against your budget target.

4) Preliminary economics (illustrative only)
- Using your "likely" number (75M/mo) and a target of $900 / 1M tokens, the monthly run-rate is roughly $67.5k before volume discounts. We'll show committed band pricing to get below that.

I'll turn this into a short packet (pricing table + recommended SLA + procurement steps) and send it by EOD tomorrow. Including Marissa so she can add commercial options.

Thanks — kim

On a side note, attached a short SOC 2 overview and our network diagram summary in case procurement asks early (rwd_soc2_overview.pdf).

--
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Attachments: rwd_soc2_overview.pdf, rwd_pricing_onepager.pdf
